source: RD Šíma stavba.dwg via LibreDWG 0.14.8601 DXF (/tmp/floorplan.dxf), read with ezdxf 1.4.4; DWG not modified
method: Openings = gaps in layer silná walls (polygonized double lines): facing wall-end faces 0.45-5.5 m apart with a free rectangle between, or two wall ends on one line. Every candidate was reviewed; the kept ones are listed, rejected ones in rejected_candidates. Size texts = MTEXT/TEXT inside the plan (pair "W\nH", "H (S)", single 4-digit 1800-3000) matched to the nearest opening (pairs also by width). Elevation marks O1..O11 / D1,D2,D5,D6 are only on the POHLEDY sheet, matched by façade alignment; drawn_bottom/top there are measured from the elevation frame lines relative to ±0,000.

text_conventions.W | H (two-line MTEXT): door width | door height in mm (Petr); head = height
text_conventions.H (S): window height H, sill S in parentheses; head = H + S. Checked on elevations O5, O8, O9: drawn 1.75 m to 2.50 m
text_conventions.N (single 4-digit): height of the opening top above floor; elevation O1, O2, O3, O4, O10, D5, D6 show these openings from floor (0) to N
